packaging.development_note: First attempt stopped at TB elaboration because outputs was declared after its continuous-assignment use. The declaration was moved before use; the production RTL was unchanged. The original six-profile finite matrix then passed; the failed commands and source hashes are retained separately.
self_audit: All signed input differences have magnitude <=2^W-1 and fit W+1 signed bits before orientation.
Two signed cross products are separately extended before the even median sum; the exact unsigned denominator retains its guard bit.
Synchronous slot reads are consumed after registration; SHIFT writes its old word before rereading a lower index; WRITE fills only the insertion hole.
No-slope/overflow flags are independent; the first MAX_LEN retained x levels alone determine the diagnostic no-slope predicate.
All reachable phases and all five multiply roles have immediate reset/fresh checks; EMIT probes require actual held output and blocked input observations.
Fresh full-range horizontal pairs rewrite both RAM prefixes and check zero numerator with an exact positive denominator.
Worst-case insertion is quadratic in pair population and quartic in point count; the explicit finite service bound accounts for this.
